content: When managing hospitalized patients with diabetes, whether they are newly diagnosed or have a pre-existing condition, it is recommended to involve a diabetes specialist care team. Engaging specialized diabetes care professionals has been shown to decrease the length of hospital stays, lower readmission rates, and reduce healthcare costs, while simultaneously enhancing patient outcomes. Ensuring access to trained diabetes specialists and implementing comprehensive discharge planning, which includes securing medications and necessary supplies, significantly improves the quality of care provided to these patients.
